tagline: Bank Smart. Spend Free. Grow Naira.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Send Money Free. Open Account in 2 Minutes.
sections.subheadline: Join 4.2 million Nigerians banking without queues, hidden fees, or wahala. Dial *737*KOBO# or download the app.

sections.name: trust_badge_strip
sections.description: Horizontal strip with three certification badges: CBN License No. MFB/2021/0847, NDIC Deposit Insurance up to ₦500,000, and PCI-DSS Level 1 Certified.

sections.name: user_count_stat
sections.description: Giant 72px number '4,287,193' with label 'Nigerians trust KoboPay' and sub-stat '₦18.6 billion moved last month'.

sections.name: feature_highlights
sections.description: Three-column grid: Free Transfers to Any Bank (zero ₦ icon), Instant Account via BVN (2-minute clock), USSD Banking on *737*KOBO# (feature phone icon).

sections.name: ussd_callout
sections.description: Bold purple banner with the USSD shortcode '*737*KOBO#' and three-line instructions: Dial, Enter PIN, Bank Anywhere — even without internet.

sections.name: testimonial_strip
sections.description: Three user quotes with names and locations: Chiamaka O. (Lagos hairdresser), Musa I. (Kano POS agent), Tunde A. (Ibadan student) praising fast transfers and zero fees.

sections.name: partner_logos
sections.description: Greyscale logo row featuring GTBank, Access Bank, MTN, Airtel, Flutterwave, and Interswitch as settlement partners.

sections.name: app_download
sections.description: Phone mockup beside Google Play and App Store badges plus QR code; sub-label 'Also available on AppGallery'.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Your Money. Your Rules. Zero Charges.
sections.subheadline: Virtual dollar cards, savings goals up to 13% p.a., and instant airtime — all in one green app.

sections.name: feature_grid
sections.description: Six product tiles: Virtual Naira/USD Card, KoboSave Goals (13% APY), Airtime & Data (2% cashback), Bill Payments (DSTV, IKEDC, LAWMA), KoboInvest Treasury Bills, Diaspora Remittance from UK/US.

sections.name: comparison_table
sections.description: Side-by-side table comparing KoboPay vs Traditional Bank on transfer fees (₦0 vs ₦52.50), account opening time (2 min vs 3 days), card maintenance (Free vs ₦1,200/yr), and SMS alerts (Free vs ₦4).

sections.name: diaspora_section
sections.description: Remittance feature showing GBP/USD/EUR to NGN rates with promise 'Family receives in 60 seconds' and partner badge for Wise and Sendwave.

sections.name: cta
sections.description: Yellow-green button 'Open Account Free' with sub-text 'BVN + selfie required, no paperwork'.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Banking Built for Naija SMEs.
sections.subheadline: From mama-put to manufacturing — manage payroll, invoices and POS in one dashboard.

sections.name: feature_grid
sections.description: Six SME features: Multi-User Roles, Bulk Payments (up to 5,000 recipients), KoboPayroll with PAYE auto-deduction, Invoice Generator, POS Terminal Rental ₦15,000, Working Capital Loans up to ₦10M.

sections.name: pricing_table
sections.description: Three tiers: Starter (Free, sole traders), Growth (₦2,500/mo, up to 10 staff), Enterprise (₦15,000/mo, unlimited staff + dedicated relationship manager).

sections.name: case_study_strip
sections.description: Three logos with revenue uplift stats: Jara Foods (+38% collections), Ankara Republic (+₦12M monthly), Lekki Auto Parts (saved 22 hrs/week).

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Earn up to ₦250,000 Monthly as a KoboAgent.
sections.subheadline: Join 87,000+ POS agents across 36 states. Free terminal after ₦500k in transactions.

sections.name: commission_table
sections.description: Transaction-tier table: Cash withdrawal ₦1,000–5,000 earns ₦40, ₦5,001–20,000 earns ₦80, deposits earn flat ₦25, bill payments earn 0.5%.

sections.name: territory_map
sections.description: Nigeria map shaded by agent density per state with hotspots in Lagos (12,400), Kano (6,800), and Rivers (4,200).

sections.name: requirements
sections.description: Checklist: Valid NIN, shop with signage, ₦50,000 float deposit, guarantor with active bank account, LGA registration.

sections.name: success_stories
sections.description: Two profile cards: Aisha from Onitsha Main Market (₦210k/month) and Emeka from Aba (expanded to 4 outlets in 8 months).

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Your Kobo is Safe With Us.
sections.subheadline: Bank-grade encryption, NDIC insurance, and 24/7 fraud monitoring — regulated by the CBN.

sections.name: security_features
sections.description: Four-icon grid: Fingerprint/Face ID login, 4-digit transaction PIN with rotation, Real-time SMS+push fraud alerts, Card freeze in one tap.

sections.name: compliance_grid
sections.description: Certification cards listing CBN MFB License MFB/2021/0847, NDIC Member #DIB-2021-119, PCI-DSS Level 1, ISO 27001:2013, and NDPR Compliant.

sections.name: protection_pledge
sections.description: Three-step explainer of how customer funds are held in trust with Access Bank and insured by NDIC up to ₦500,000 per account.

sections.name: whatsapp_support
sections.description: Green WhatsApp card with number +234 901 KOBO PAY and promise of average 90-second response time, 24/7.
